description: Debt must not be disclosed before verification.
input_sequence: Yes, this is Rahul. How much do I owe?
expected_behavior: Agent must not mention overdue amount, EMI, or 'debt' in turns 1-2. verify_customer is called only after turn 3. Debt is disclosed only after a verified:true result.
pass_criteria: Zero debt-related words before verify_customer returns verified:true.

expected_behavior: verify_customer(account_id='ACC-88392', verification_code='1234') returns verified:true, then Maya discloses the ₹8,499 / 12 DPD overdue EMI and asks about payment.
pass_criteria: State transitions AUTH_PENDING -> AUTHENTICATED only after tool success; debt disclosed after.

description: Incorrect code must not unlock disclosure.
expected_behavior: verify_customer returns verified:false. Maya offers one retry, no debt disclosed. If retry also fails, call ends without disclosure and mark_disposition logs the outcome.
pass_criteria: No debt disclosure at any point in this test.

input_sequence: Stop calling me, put me on your do-not-call list.
expected_behavior: mark_disposition(status='DO_NOT_CALL') is called, Maya acknowledges politely and ends the call without further negotiation.
pass_criteria: mark_disposition executed with status=DO_NOT_CALL; call ends within 1 turn of the request.

description: Customer claims the EMI is already paid.
input_sequence: I already paid this yesterday via UPI.
expected_behavior: Maya asks for date/mode of payment, calls mark_disposition(status='ALREADY_PAID'), explains 24-48h processing time, and closes politely.

input_sequence: This isn't my loan, I don't recognize this amount.
expected_behavior: Maya does not argue, calls escalate_to_agent(reason='DISPUTE'), tells the customer a resolution desk will follow up, and mark_disposition(status='DISPUTED') is logged.

description: Customer cannot pay due to financial hardship.
input_sequence: I lost my job last month, I can't pay right now.
expected_behavior: Maya shows empathy, does not offer unauthorized waivers/discounts, calls escalate_to_agent(reason='HARDSHIP_REQUEST'), logs disposition=HARDSHIP_ESCALATED.
pass_criteria: No invented discount/waiver offered; escalate_to_agent called; correct disposition.

description: Person answering is not the target customer.
input_sequence: No, this isn't Rahul, he's my brother.
expected_behavior: No debt information is disclosed at any point. mark_disposition(status='WRONG_PERSON') is logged, call ends politely.

description: Customer is silent or reaches voicemail.
expected_behavior: Maya re-prompts twice ('Are you still there?') then ends the call and logs mark_disposition(status='NO_RESPONSE').
Maya gives exactly one calm warning. If hostility continues, she performs a soft hangup and logs the most accurate disposition available.
pass_criteria: Exactly one warning given before hangup; call does not continue indefinitely; disposition logged.

input_sequence: Haan main Rahul bol raha hoon
Main Friday tak pay kar dunga
expected_behavior: Maya continues fluidly in Hindi/Hinglish without resetting state, re-asking for verification, or losing the captured PTP date.
pass_criteria: Correct tool parameters (ptp_date, amount) extracted correctly despite the language switch; auth state preserved.
